legacy.status: Pending migration. Used only by Showroom.tsx, Services.tsx, Enquiry.tsx and the OpenStatus component on the homepage. Not part of the system.

display-1.purpose: Route openers at cinematic scale; the Accommodation headline and door-sign state run at this scale.

display-2.purpose: Cinematic openers: homepage showroom title, Construction hero, footer closing line.

headline.purpose: Page, range and stage titles; editorial H1s run from here to about 60px.

title-sm.purpose: Product lines, service rows, stage-strip names, range links.

small.purpose: Secondary lines, fact values, footer columns, header status.

label.purpose: Uppercase, tabular. Codes, table keys, footer heads, Field Note headers, image labels. Never an eyebrow.

action.purpose: Buttons and text links, sentence case. Nav links are Inter 500 15px.

shadows.name: field-note-lift
shadows.purpose: Only under a Field Note floating over the journey scene (a filter, so it follows the cut).

shadows.name: dialog-backdrop
shadows.purpose: Behind the phone schedule sheet; the counter view uses opaque #0C1A28.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Lines are inset box-shadows: secondary buttons, inputs, chips, codes. Not elevation.

cuts.name: cut-action
cuts.value: 10px at 45deg, top right, via linear-gradient(225deg, transparent var(--cut), var(--action-bg) calc(var(--cut) + 0.5px))
cuts.purpose: Primary action only; the gradient keeps the focus ring visible.

cuts.name: cut-note
cuts.purpose: Midnight Field Note plates: journey notes, the docked schedule, its index cell, the phone schedule sheet.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All UI feedback transitions; never bounce or overshoot.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Hover colour, ring and underline changes.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Arrow nudge (3px), row wash, Field Note reveal.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Journey plate turning to midnight at dusk.

motion.name: carousel-open
motion.purpose: Showroom carousel: a range opens as a window from its thumbnail to full screen; headline lines rise 12px with 60ms stagger. Manual only.

motion.name: logo-loader
motion.value: at most about 3.6s, skippable, once per session
motion.purpose: Construction lines, letters, fills, the panes glance and blink, the star opens. Loading screen afterwards; none under reduced motion.

motion.name: journey
motion.value: scrubbed to native scroll on a sticky stage
motion.purpose: Holds at each Field Note, reverses exactly; reduced motion shows each chapter's final still with its notes open.

narrative.northStar: The Showroom After Dark, Set as a Drawing Sheet
narrative.overview:
Kenstar is architectural editorial luxury: Swiss order, contemporary architecture, the showroom's own photography and the plain honesty of construction documents. Two environments carry every page. Midnight is the hour the chandeliers are lit, and it holds the cinematic and arrival moments: the header, the homepage showroom, the visit sections, the door sign, the enquiry bands and the footer. Limestone is the showroom by day, the warm stone of its floor and walls, and it holds reading and browsing: Products, Construction, About and Contact. White serves one page, the Accommodation spread, as an interiors magazine would.

Structure comes from rules, not boxes. Sections open on a 2px rule, ledgers and schedules are ruled with hairlines, facts sit in key and value rows, and codes are set in tracked technical type. Corners are square everywhere except one cut: the 45° chamfer from the KENST★R wordmark, which marks the primary action and the midnight Field Note. Photography is evidence. It is cropped and lightly corrected, never tinted, and every stand-in or render says what it is.

Motion is construction, and only three experiences perform: the logo loader, the showroom carousel and the homepage journey. Everywhere else, motion is feedback: a 160ms colour change, a 3px arrow nudge, a 1px press.
keyCharacteristics: Two environments, midnight and limestone, alternate by purpose, with white for the Accommodation spread.
Brass marks what is selected or current and fills the one primary on midnight. Star gold lives only in the logo.
Manrope for everything large, Inter for everything read or measured.
A 2px rule opens each section, hairlines rule everything else, and there are no cards.
Square corners, with a 45° cut on primary actions (10px) and Field Notes (14px).
Only three experiences animate. Elsewhere, motion is feedback only.
Images say what they are: "Illustrative photo" on stand-in stock, "Visualisation" on renders.

rules.name: The Brass Marks the Choice Rule
rules.body: Brass shows what is selected, current or active, and fills the one primary action on midnight. It is never a decorative line, a background wash outside a selection, or running text. Brass at full strength is never text on limestone or white (2.6:1). Brass ink carries accent text there.

rules.name: The Logo Owns the Star Rule
rules.body: Star gold and logo navy appear only inside the logo. They are not UI colours, not a selection colour, and not a highlight.

rules.name: The Environment Changes, the Box Doesn't Rule
rules.body: A section is either midnight or limestone (white on Accommodation). Midnight deep is a ground for plates, images and the footer, never a third section colour.

rules.name: The Two Faces, Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Manrope never goes below 20px and Inter never above 24px. Headings are 600 at display sizes and 700 at Title sizes. Text is 400, and emphasis is Inter 600, never colour or caps.

rules.name: The Caps Carry Facts Rule
rules.body: Tracked caps carry codes, table keys, captions, note headers and image labels, and nothing else. There are no eyebrows or kickers: a caps label never sits above a headline to introduce it. A block has at most one.

rules.name: The Strong Heading Rule
rules.body: On light grounds, headings take text-strong (midnight) and body takes graphite. A heading is never soft.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats except the Field Note. A container is separated by a rule, a hairline or a change of environment, never a drop shadow, blur or glass layer.

rules.name: The One Cut Rule
rules.body: The 45° cut appears on the primary action and on midnight Field Note plates, nowhere else. No radii, no pills, no rounded photos.

dos: **Do** build every section in an environment class (`env-midnight`, `env-limestone`, `env-white`) and style through its roles (surface, text, text-strong, line, accent, action-bg).
**Do** give each view one primary: filled, with a 10px cut. Brass on midnight, midnight on limestone and white. Keep the header's WhatsApp outlined.
**Do** open sections, ranges and stages with a 2px text-strong rule, and rule lists and facts with 1px hairlines.
**Do** set codes, keys, captions and image labels in 12px Inter caps at +0.08em with tabular figures.
**Do** label stand-in stock "Illustrative photo" and every render "Visualisation", and embed provenance in every shipping raster.
**Do** use the authored icon set (24px grid, 1.75 stroke, square caps, mitre joins) at 18–20px.
**Do** keep touch targets at 44px or more, and the focus ring at 2px in the environment's focus colour.
**Do** let enquiries open WhatsApp or email with the message written. The site itself sends nothing.
donts: **Don't** use star gold (#F59E0B) or logo navy (#0B2D52) outside the logo, or show the full-colour logo on midnight.
**Don't** use brass as decoration or as running text on light grounds. It marks selection and fills the primary on midnight.
**Don't** put a tracked-caps eyebrow or kicker above a headline.
**Don't** round corners, add drop shadows (except under a Field Note), or use blur or glass.
**Don't** cut a corner anywhere but the primary action and midnight Field Note plates.
**Don't** animate outside the logo loader, the showroom carousel and the journey: no scroll fades, parallax or cursor effects.
**Don't** tint, duotone or recolour product photography, or present stock or rendered images as Kenstar's own.
**Don't** build new work on the legacy palette or classes (`--paper`, `--navy`, `--gold`, `.btn-gold`, `.letter`, Archivo, Barlow).
